title: Create: Interstellar
description: Create: Interstellar is a progression-focused tech modpack centered around Create, Ad Astra, and AE2. Start with only rotational power, reach the stars with Ad Astra, unlock AE2 through space exploration, and eventually develop quantum technology.
body:
# Create: Interstellar

Create: Interstellar is a progression-focused technology modpack built around [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create), [Ad Astra](https://modrinth.com/mod/ad-astra), [Applied Energistics 2](https://modrinth.com/mod/ae2), and [Advanced AE](https://modrinth.com/mod/advancedae). The pack follows a structured tech tree that begins with mechanical automation and ends with interstellar quantum infrastructure.

Players begin with Create as the primary progression system. Early gameplay focuses on building factories using rotational power, mechanical belts, shafts, and contraptions to automate resource production and processing. Most early recipes and production chains rely on Create machinery, making it the foundation of all progression.

## World and Exploration
![Create Windmill Structure](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d604f995997fcea360971dd88b90b29ae658990d.webp)
The Overworld is generated by [Teralith](https://modrinth.com/mod/terralith), adding varied terrain. Additionally many new Create structures are added to further improve Overworld exploration. The Nether and End are expanded using [Better Nether](https://modrinth.com/mod/betternether) and [Better End](https://modrinth.com/mod/betterend), introducing new biomes, resources, and exploration opportunities required for mid-game progression.

New structures are also added across Ad Astra’s planets and moons, encouraging exploration beyond the Overworld as part of the progression path rather than optional content.

## Mechanical Progression (Create)

Create is required for nearly all early and mid-game automation. Players must design production lines using mechanical power to produce components required for further technological advancement. Many crafting recipes across the pack are modified to require Create-based production chains rather than vanilla crafting.

## Space Progression (Ad Astra)
![Mars temple](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b96430ce545b59727274c56a547e681ffac988a8.webp)
Space travel is a core progression milestone. Ad Astra is rebalanced so that rockets and planetary travel require significant Create progression. Players must establish a stable mechanical industry before accessing space.

New planets provide essential resources required for later technological tiers, making space exploration mandatory for progression.

## Electricity and Applied Energistics 2
![Create: Crafts and Additions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cb54eae7564d33fe9d5568e674934ad50978587d.webp)
Electricity is unlocked after progressing to Mars, marking a major transition from mechanical systems to electrical infrastructure. Once unlocked, power generation is made possible by [Create Crafts & Additions](https://modrinth.com/mod/createaddition).

Applied Energistics 2 is unlocked with electricity becoming available. AE2 systems allow players to build network-based storage, item logistics, and automated crafting systems that replace earlier physical storage and transport methods.

## Endgame and Advanced AE

Advanced AE expands on AE2 with highly advanced quantum-level technology and powerful items. Progression into Advanced AE requires players to travel beyond the Solar System to obtain necessary materials.

The endgame focuses on combining automation, digital logistics, and space exploration into a complete progression system.
